text:
I would like to report an issue with the website "Ask Nebula."
I accessed their service through an Facebook ad offering a quiz to discover my astrological card. The initial offer was to complete the quiz and pay $1 through Apple Pay, which I accepted. After paying the $1, I was directed to another page that advertised subscription services. I wanted to navigate away and simply view my quiz results without signing up for any subscription. However, without my permission and without the usual Face ID verification that Apple Pay normally requires, an $77.3 charge was processed through my Apple Pay account. I was not informed clearly that an $77.3 charge would be made, nor did I authorize it. There was no charge was processed through my Apple Pay account. I was not informed clearly that an $77.3 charge would be made, nor did I authorize it. There was no opportunity to confirm or cancel the transaction. When I tried to seek support, the only option available was sending a complaint and they refused to refund the money and instead offering me As an exception, you’re receiving a 50% refund, 150 credits, and two complimentary readings, making it impossible to properly address or resolve the issue. I’m not interested on any of these I want my money back is Xmas time and I need that money as is been designated to something else. THEY ARE SCAMMERS DO NOT USE THIS SERVICE OR APP. 
I believe this
business practice is deceptive and breaches consumer trust.
I am seeking a full refund and request that Consumer Affairs investigates this company for potential fraudulent behavior.
rationale: 77.30 went through Apple Pay without the usual Face ID and without a confirmation step, moments after an accepted 1-dollar charge, so it renewed nothing. A 50% settlement was refused and Consumer Affairs is named.
